# Tabs

Switch between peer panels while coordinating focus and activation.

## Examples

### Manual

Move focus between tabs without activating a panel until selection is confirmed.

<ComponentExample component="tabs" scenario="manual" title="Manual" description="Move focus between tabs without activating a panel until selection is confirmed." :index="0" />

### Automatic

Advance automatically while still exposing pause and direct navigation controls.

<ComponentExample component="tabs" scenario="automatic" title="Automatic" description="Advance automatically while still exposing pause and direct navigation controls." :index="1" />

## Keyboard interaction

| Key | Behavior |
| --- | --- |
| <kbd>Arrow Left</kbd> / <kbd>Arrow Right</kbd> | Move between tabs in a horizontal list. |
| <kbd>Arrow Up</kbd> / <kbd>Arrow Down</kbd> | Move between tabs in a vertical list. |
| <kbd>Home</kbd> / <kbd>End</kbd> | Move to the first or last tab. |
| <kbd>Enter</kbd> / <kbd>Space</kbd> | Activate the focused tab in manual activation mode. |

## Accessibility

The tab list connects every tab to one tab panel and preserves selected, disabled, and orientation state.

See the [corresponding WAI-ARIA pattern](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/tabs/) for the host accessibility contract.
